name: Circle of Flora (Druid Circle)
body:
You share a love of all things that grow and show great respect for the verdant spaces of the world whether they be remote jungle valleys or stubborn growths among city streets.

Bonus Spells: entangle (1st), barkskin (2nd), plant growth (3rd). command plants (4th), wall of thorns (5th), repel wood (6th), animate plants (7th), control plants (8th), shambler (9th).

Manifestation: Your hair begins to grow thick and vine-like, your skin gains a tinge of plant-like green, you may even begin to smell slightly of flowers or sap.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Green Thumb (Su)

The Circle of Flora promotes that the bounty of nature is for all to partake in and happily shares that gift wherever they go. Once per day as a standard action you may cause a single, living, non-magical plant that you touch and is no larger than an apple tree to grow and flower as though it had grown to its peak maturity in ideal conditions.

The plant remains in this state for 24 hours and then reverts to its previous natural state. Anything clipped or picked from the plant during this time remains and is unaffected when the plant reverts to its previous natural state. You may use this ability an additional time per day by expending a spell slot, doing so increases the duration of the effect by 24 hours per spell level of the slot expended (it will continue to grow into a harvestable state each day for the duration) and you may have a number of plants augmented at once equal to your class level. When you reach this limit and use the ability again, the oldest affected plant reverts to its previous natural state. You may use this ability to extend the duration of any currently affected plant when the duration would otherwise end, doing so does not require you to touch the plant, you only need to be within 1 mile of it. This ability has no effect on creatures of the plant type.

Floral Bounty (Su)

At 8th level your knowledge and skill of the cultivation and energies of plant-life grows and you gain Cultivate Magical Plants as a bonus feat without meeting its prerequisites except that cultivating a magical plant only takes a legendary druid 1 day per 1,000gp in the base price rather than 1 week per 1,000gp in the base price. In addition any fruit or clipping harvested from a magical plant you cultivated remains potent for 1 week before losing its magical properties rather than 1 day and can be kept potent by using magic such as Gentle Repose and similar effects.

One with the Green (Su)

At 16th level, your life force has become intrinsically entangled with the verdant energy you channel. You now count as the plant type in addition to your own type. For the purposes of abilities that would affect you based on type you are treated as the type of your choice. In addition, you gain a +4 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects and a +2 bonus to your existing natural armor as well as DR 5/slashing. You also can now be sustained with only 1 gallon of water and 2 hours of light a day without suffering from starvation.

Druidic talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

Improved Green Thumb (Su)

(Major Talent)

Your Green Thumb ability is now usable at will, the duration is permanent, and you can maintain a number of augmented plants equal to twice your class level. When you use the ability, if you have reached this limit, you can choose which previously augmented plant to end the effect on.

Photosynthesis (Su)

(Grand Talent)

Your plant nature allows you to heal quickly. While in direct sunlight, you gain fast healing 5. You can regenerate lost limbs by spending 8 hours in direct sunlight.
